issues: 前后两页是灰色占位线框 dashboard，还压着一行 "Next Page" 调试标题
白底页面上 screen 漏光几乎不显色，只在深色侧栏上读成一块脏棕
光峰时旧页仍清晰可读，切点没有被真正藏住
漏光和画面内容无关，光只是叠在页面上的装饰
changes: look 换成 ember 暗场，做成相机 App「Ondo」的取景器：A 夜景（星点、新月、山脊剪影、一盏暖窗灯）「Made for the dark.」→ B 黄昏（赤橙天空、半落的太阳）「Made for the light.」，漏光本身就是"天亮了"
取景器 UI 让它像产品：四角取景框、等宽曝光参数（ISO 3200 → ISO 100）、底部模式拨轮，光峰后高亮滑块从 NIGHT 滑到 GOLDEN HOUR
漏光三段色温（白热核 / 琥珀 / 余烬橙 / 赭红外缘）的拉长椭圆渐变 + 右上缘片门溢光光带，全部 screen 叠加、不用 blur 滤镜
峰值烧穿加重：brightness +85% / contrast −50% / 40% 暖罩 + 热核 intensity³，A 标题随光强淡到 25%，峰值帧七成以上画面烧白再硬切
节奏：标题逐词升起 → 24–52f ease-in 蓄力 → 52f 藏切 → 43f ease-out 余温里 B 镜头 1.04→1 落定、B 标题逐词升起，hold 35f
issuesEn: Both pages were grey wireframe placeholder dashboards, with a leftover "Next Page" debug title on top
On the white page the screen-blended leak barely showed colour and only read as a muddy brown patch on the dark sidebar
At the peak the old page was still clearly legible, so the cut wasn't really hidden
The leak had nothing to do with the content; it was just decoration laid over a page
changesEn: Dark ember look as the viewfinder of a camera app, "Ondo": A is a night scene (stars, crescent moon, ridge silhouettes, one warm cabin light) with "Made for the dark.", B is golden hour (orange sky, setting sun) with "Made for the light.", so the leak itself is the sunrise
Viewfinder UI makes it a product: corner frame marks, mono exposure readout (ISO 3200 → ISO 100) and a mode dial whose highlight slides from NIGHT to GOLDEN HOUR after the peak

A three-temperature leak (white-hot core, amber, ember orange, rust fringe) built from elongated elliptical gradients plus a gate-flare band along the top-right edge, all screen-blended with no blur filters
Heavier burn at the peak: brightness +85%, contrast −50%, a 40% warm wash and a core at intensity³; A's title fades to 25% with the light, so over 70% of the frame is blown out on the cut frame

Rhythm: the title rises word by word, the leak builds with ease-in over 24–52f, the cut hides at 52f, then during the 43f ease-out afterglow B settles from 1.04 to 1 and its title rises word by word, followed by a 35f hold
